svg.title: Muktanan Mohapatra, tinySage
svg.desc: A printed ECG strip on pink grid paper. Header: MOHAPATRA, MUKTANAN; ID tinySage; CSE, ITER (SOA), Bhubaneswar; monitoring since Oct 2026. Interpretation: Sinus rhythm. Unconfirmed. Awaiting review by Maranello. The lead II trace runs a few beats, then lifts into the handwritten name Muktanan.
